explication: PaperOrchestra turns research ideas and experimental logs into conference-ready LaTeX papers. The principal workflow is the CLI or interactive demo invoking a paper-writer orchestrator, which coordinates outlining, literature synthesis, section drafting, and iterative refinement; an optional plotting variant adds generated visuals. Shared utilities provide model backends and PDF/LaTeX handling. The README documents these capabilities, while the excerpts show several orchestration calls; some unsampled subsystem links are therefore omitted rather than inferred.
